name: VoiceFleet
tagline: Answer business calls, handle FAQs, take messages, and book appointments with an AI receptionist.
description: VoiceFleet is an inbound AI voice receptionist for small businesses. It uses customer-configured instructions and FAQs to answer calls, capture caller details or messages, book appointments through compatible calendar integrations, and escalate calls under configured rules; businesses can forward an existing number and receive call summaries. The paid service offers a 7-day free trial.
